title: dryopteris chrysotricha
intro: Dryopteris chrysotricha, commonly known as Golden Rattlesnake Fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is a type of fern, specifically a deciduous, perennial fern with golden-colored hairs on its rachises, which are used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Dryopteris chrysotricha include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and lower blood pressure. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and coumarins.
